scope: Independent raw SOXS USD audit through SEIBRO 2026-11-03; 2026 daily comparisons; 2025 used only for lagged percentile inputs. No pre-2025 performance conclusions.

method.raw: Deduplicate each settlement-date/ISIN across d1..d4; use first list and verify all duplicates identical; sum four SOXS chained ISIN USD amounts without split multiplication.
method.calendar: Independently reconstruct NYSE and settlement dates, federal holidays, T+1/T+2, SEIBRO +1 weekday; recompute 41-date centered median and cal merge spans.
method.unit: Sum SOXS settlement rows within independently reconstructed unit, divide equally by count of US trade dates; mark wholly and partly censored Top50 absence.
method.percentile: 2025 onward only; gross5 requires all five uncensored/nonpartial days; rolling last250 including current with at least120 valid; 100*(strictly_lower+0.5*equal)/valid_count.
method.timing: Next KSD businessday after last unit settlement at09:00 KST; first NYSE session on/after that date; lag1 adds one US session.
